name: Baker Hughes
description: Baker Hughes has two halves of almost equal size. Oilfield Services & Equipment (52 percent of 2025 revenue) sells drilling, completions, artificial lift, subsea and chemicals to oil and gas producers, largely well by well, so it rises and falls with drilling activity. Industrial & Energy Technology (48 percent) builds gas turbines, compressors and LNG and power equipment, sells long-running aftermarket services and industrial sensors and valves, and holds $32.4 billion of the company's $35.9 billion contracted backlog (RPO); this is the growth engine, with 2025 revenue up 10 percent against OFSE down 8 percent. Segment EBITDA was nearly even (OFSE $2.6 billion, IET $2.5 billion). In July 2026 it closed the $13.6 billion acquisition of Chart Industries, and in January 2026 sold its PSI sensors business for about $1.2 billion and put its surface pressure control unit into a joint venture with Cactus.

gics.note: Wikipedia list gives only sector and sub-industry; industry group and industry were not in a source read, so left null. Fact for the reader: 48 percent of FY2025 revenue (IET) is turbines, compressors, sensors and flow-control equipment and services for gas, power and industrial customers; the other 52 percent (OFSE) is oilfield services and equipment.

businessLines.name: Oilfield Services & Equipment (OFSE)
businessLines.how: Oil and gas producers pay per well or per job for drilling tools, services and equipment (well-by-well, no obligation to keep buying) and for subsea equipment on longer projects; revenue follows drilling and completion activity and pricing.
businessLines.description: Products, services and integrated solutions for oil and gas wells, onshore and offshore, from exploration to decommissioning; also geothermal and CCUS

businessLines.name: Industrial & Energy Technology (IET)
businessLines.how: Equipment sold on multi-year projects (turbines and compressors for LNG, pipelines and power) recognised over delivery, then long-term service contracts on the installed base; industrial products are shorter-cycle component sales.
businessLines.description: Gas turbines, compressors, LNG and power equipment plus aftermarket services, industrial sensors, valves and inspection, and climate technology (CCUS, hydrogen, geothermal)
